_note: Trade-plan settings (scripts/dhan_refresh/tradeplan.py). capital 1,00,000 and max_loss_per_trade 1,000 confirmed by the owner on 17 Nov 2026. daily_loss_limit 2,000 is still an example value. Research software, not advice: the desk prints a plan to place by hand and never sends orders.
_product_note: delivery (hold for days) matches the back-test, which holds up to 21 trading days. intraday must be closed the same day, so the multi-day odds below would not apply to it.
_stop_k_note: stop = entry minus stop_k times one day's volatility (risklab daily vol when present, else ATR 14). Assumed; the skills' default is a 1.5 ATR stop.
